facts.text: I am trying to get organized with my properties.
I want a spreadsheet to keep track of my land ownership and expenses.
I want to add another sheet to track the permits and licenses I need for each property.
I want to add a column to the property list sheet to track the type of property (residential, commercial, or vacant land).
I want to add a column to the Expenses by Property sheet to track the payment method (cash, credit card, or check).
I want to add a column to the Property List sheet to track the current status of each property (Active, Under Construction, or Vacant).
I want to add a column to the Property List sheet to track the property manager or contact person responsible for each property.
